info.name: 📌 Cohere API
info.description:
### About

"Cohere builds powerful models and AI solutions enabling enterprises to automate processes, empower employees, and turn fragmented data into actionable insights."

Cohere builds its own Command, Embed and Rerank models for enterprise search and RAG. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Model makers**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- Cohere Account: [https://cohere.com/](https://cohere.com/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `cohere_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:cohere_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://docs.cohere.com/reference/about](https://docs.cohere.com/reference/about)
    
- Models: [https://docs.cohere.com/docs/models](https://docs.cohere.com/docs/models)
